ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a pentagon, with vertices labeled in order U, V, W, Y, Z. Angle expressions are labeled near each vertex: at U is (x-8)°, at V is (3x-11)°, at W is (x+8)°, at Y is x°, and at Z is (2x+7)°. The problem asks to find m∠V. Reasoning: The sum of the interior angles of a pentagon is (5-2)×180°=540°. According to the five interior angle expressions given in the figure, set up the equation: (x-8)+(3x-11)+(x+8)+x+(2x+7)=540. Combining like terms gives 8x-4=540, so 8x=544, x=68. The expression for ∠V is 3x-11, therefore m∠V=3(68)-11=204-11=193.
